title: astragalus pseudotataricus
intro: Astragalus pseudotataricus, commonly known as Chinese milkvetch or Mongolian milkvetch, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus pseudotataricus include enhancing immune function, reducing oxidative stress, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
